fusions.name: Loosed Drift
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow of water at a target up to 9 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach, with a 30% chance to leave it [Fatigued] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Three on One Lungful
fusions.desc: After a 2-second draw, looses 3 arrows of water at once, spread apart, each dealing 12 damage that ignores armour.

fusions.name: Long Calm
fusions.desc: After a 1-second cast, your attacks and spells reach 1.3 times as far for 30 seconds.

fusions.name: Rested String
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your next strike gains 15% critical hit chance. Once every 20 seconds.
